instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence in a vertical 9:16 frame. Create a premium handcrafted envelope inspired by the visual language of Disney’s The Little Mermaid and Pixar’s Luca, without reproducing copyrighted characters or logos. The envelope has a soft serenity blue base, elegant candy-orange accents and luminous pearl details, with realistic matte paper texture, subtle fibers, pearlescent finish, refined folds and precise geometry. Adorn it with a finely detailed seashell-shaped wax seal, delicate satin ribbon, tiny pearl embellishments and subtle ocean-inspired ornamental motifs.

Place the envelope in a rich, story-driven seaside environment during a dreamy sunset: a calm ocean horizon, gentle waves, wet sand reflecting the sky, distant rocky formations, delicate sea foam, seashells and small pieces of coral arranged organically around it. Use serenity blue in the sea and sky, candy orange in the sunset glow and pearl white in the highlights, foam and ornaments. Add subtle floating particles, tiny sparkling droplets, translucent bubbles and delicate sea-inspired elements drifting through the air, enhancing the magical atmosphere without overpowering the envelope.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with warm orange sunset key light illuminating the envelope, cool blue ambient fill from the ocean, delicate pearl-like rim light outlining its edges, and soft volumetric rays passing through the humid coastal atmosphere. Include subtle mist, sea spray, atmospheric haze and luminous reflections on the wet sand. Shadows should be soft, realistic and directional, with harmonious gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, expressive ocean sunset background softly defocused but clearly recognizable, strong depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the paper texture, seashell seal, ribbon and pearl ornaments, cinematic bokeh from the sunset reflections. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium seaside invitation aesthetic, inspired by Disney’s The Little Mermaid and Pixar’s Luca while remaining original and free of recognizable characters, logos or franchise artwork. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade rendering, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations, celebrations and storytelling visuals. Aspect ratio: 9:16.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a blank premium sheet of paper as the central and main subject, occupying almost the entire vertical frame while preserving visible space around it to reveal the floor, background and lateral decorative elements. The sheet is pristine, unmarked and ready for custom text, with elegant rectangular geometry, subtly rounded edges, realistic pearlescent paper texture, soft fibers, delicate satin finish and refined ivory-pearl luminosity. It rests naturally on a sophisticated reflective floor, with gentle shadows beneath it and enough surrounding surface visible to create depth and grounding. Around the sheet, arrange carefully curated ocean-inspired ornaments: seashells, small polished pearls, delicate coral branches, translucent sea glass, tiny starfish, smooth stones, flowing ribbons resembling waves, scattered petals and subtle sparkling particles. The adornments should frame the sheet organically without covering its blank surface, with larger elements positioned along the lateral edges and lower corners, creating a luxurious editorial invitation composition.

The background forms a recognizable yet softly defocused sunset-by-the-sea environment, with a serene horizon, calm ocean waves, warm sky gradients, distant silhouettes of coastal rocks and subtle reflections across the floor. Create a magical twilight atmosphere inspired by the franchises Disney, Pixar, The Little Mermaid, Moana and Barbie, blending fairytale elegance, oceanic wonder, playful sophistication and cinematic fantasy realism, without adding characters, logos, lettering or copyrighted symbols. The color palette is intentionally harmonious: serenity blue dominating the sky, ocean reflections and shadows; candy orange illuminating the sunset horizon, coral accents and warm highlights; and pearlescent white adding luminosity to the sheet, shells, pearls and atmospheric glows. Add soft pink-orange sunset reflections, controlled contrast and luminous gradients.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a warm orange key light from the setting sun, cool serenity-blue ambient fill light, delicate rim light outlining the sheet, shells and pearls, and subtle volumetric rays crossing the background. Include gentle ocean mist, atmospheric haze, floating glowing dust and tiny highlights that catch the light, creating a dreamy premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. Composition: portrait 9:16, sheet sharply in focus and occupying approximately 75–85% of the frame, ample clean blank area preserved for writing, visible floor beneath, softly recognizable sunset-sea background above and around it, lateral ornaments framing but never overpowering the central sheet. Camera: refined editorial photography, slightly elevated frontal perspective, macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and adornments, cinematic bokeh in distant sunset reflections. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, flawless composition, no text, no handwriting, no watermark, no people, no characters, no objects covering the blank sheet. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations, celebrations and storytelling visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Tipo pôr do sol, elementos do mar) e na paleta de cores (Azul serenity, laranja candy e pérola). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Aniversário Yasmin". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Você não deve acrescentar data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
aberturaSlide4Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
